cc:Work.dc:description: Six panels place the original root effects at their measured prompt lengths. Equal prompt lengths can overlap; no curve is fitted. Each panel retains its separate overall square and confidence interval. The longest A5000 prompt, train/279, is an open diamond slightly below zero under speculation at fixed P4. This is a diagnostic alternative to the selected rank plot.
